title: How is Kim Jong Un connected to King Henry VIII?
description:
A border handshake, a D-Day ceremony and four centuries of English monarchs link Kim Jong Un to Henry VIII.

Kim Jong Un → Donald Trump → Elizabeth II → Henry VIII

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
